temp-mail: Can I send email or recover a forgotten account?
This tool receives messages; it is not a permanent mailbox or an account-recovery service. Use an address you control long term for purchases, subscriptions, and important accounts.
Does a new address erase messages at the provider?
No. Changing the address ends access through this page but does not guarantee deletion from the email provider. Do not use temporary mail for sensitive correspondence or to bypass a service's rules.
background-remover: Why does the first image take longer?
The browser loads the image-processing model and runtime before it can remove a background. Wait for the status message and keep the tab open. A smaller image can help a device with limited memory.
No. Hair, glass, shadows, and a subject that blends into the background can produce rough edges. Inspect the transparent output at full size and retain the original for manual corrections.
pdf-merge: Will merging make scanned pages searchable?
No. Merging copies pages into a combined document; it does not run optical character recognition. An image-only scan remains image-only.
How do I check the final document?
Open the downloaded PDF, check its page count and order, and inspect important pages. Forms, signatures, bookmarks, and other document features may not survive a merge as you expect.
image-to-pdf: Why does the PDF contain large or differently sized pages?
Pages follow the dimensions of the source images. Prepare consistently sized, upright images first if the final document needs a uniform appearance.
No. It places images into PDF pages without recognizing text. Keep the images readable and use a separate OCR workflow if searchable text is required.
qr-code-generator: Can I change the destination after downloading a code?
The generated code stores the text you supplied. To change it, generate a new code. If you encode a URL you control, you may change what that URL serves separately.
What should I test before printing?
Scan the actual downloaded image at its intended printed size. Check the destination, preserve a blank margin, and avoid placing a logo or decoration over the code.
password-generator: Can I recover a generated password later?
The tool does not provide a password vault or recovery history. Save a password in a password manager before leaving the page, and avoid sending it through email or support forms.
What if a website rejects the password?
Check that site's length and character requirements, adjust the generator settings, and generate a new value. Use a different password for every account.
word-counter: Why does another editor show a different count?
Word boundaries vary between applications, particularly for punctuation, hyphenated words, and languages without spaces. Use the destination platform's count when a submission has a strict limit.
Are character limits the same everywhere?
No. Platforms can count line breaks, spaces, emoji, and Unicode characters differently. Check the final text in the place where it will be submitted.
json-formatter: Does valid JSON mean my configuration is correct?
No. Syntax validation confirms the data can be parsed. It does not check your application's schema, required fields, permissions, or business rules.
Can formatting change numbers or duplicate properties?

Parsing and re-serializing JSON can lose duplicate property names and precision for numbers beyond JavaScript's safe integer range. Keep a source copy and represent large identifiers as strings where your application allows it.
base64-tool: No. It is a reversible representation, not encryption. Do not share a Base64 value if the original text contains a secret.
Why does a JWT section fail in a standard Base64 decoder?
JWTs use Base64URL, which differs in its alphabet and padding conventions. Use the JWT Decoder for token headers and payloads; decoding does not verify their authenticity.
user-agent-generator: Does this change my browser identity?
No. It creates a sample text string for your test data. It does not change the current browser, emulate a device, or bypass access restrictions.
Are the samples the latest browser releases?
Treat the strings as examples, not a current release directory. Verify any exact version requirement separately and test real browsers when behavior matters.
color-palette-generator: Does a generated palette meet accessibility contrast requirements?
A palette alone does not establish contrast. Check the exact text and background pair, font size, and control boundaries before using the colors in an interface.
How do I keep a color while exploring alternatives?
Use the lock control for the swatch you want to retain, then generate again. Copy the color value or export CSS variables when you have a combination you want to keep.
unit-converter: Should I round the input before converting?
Keep the available input precision and round the final result for your use case. Repeated rounding can introduce avoidable differences.
Can I convert between unrelated measurement types?
Choose units in the same supported category. Length, weight, and temperature measure different quantities and cannot be converted into each other by this tool.
url-encoder-decoder: Why did a percent sign become %25?
That commonly happens when an already encoded value is encoded again. Inspect the original value and apply the transformation once at the correct boundary.
Does decoding prove a link is safe?
No. Decoding only changes the representation. Review the complete destination and do not open a suspicious link merely because it is readable.
jwt-decoder: Can I edit a decoded claim to gain access?
Changing a payload does not produce a valid signed token. A correctly configured server verifies the signature and claims before accepting it.
An ordinary signed JWT exposes readable header and payload data. This tool handles compact three-part tokens, not encrypted JWE messages. Never paste a live token into a support request.
unix-timestamp-converter: Why do UTC and local time show different hours?
They display the same instant using different timezone rules. Share the UTC value or an explicit timezone when communicating timestamps between systems.
Does the tool fix a wrong system clock?
No. Local time displays and comparisons depend on the device and browser. Confirm your device clock and the source timestamp unit when results look unexpected.
hash-generator: Why do two visually identical texts have different hashes?
Invisible spaces, line endings, and Unicode representations change the input bytes. Compare the exact input before assuming the hashing algorithm is wrong.
Can I use a plain SHA digest to store passwords?
This tool computes general-purpose text digests. Password storage requires a purpose-built password hashing scheme with appropriate salts and work factors in your application.
csv-to-json: Values such as postal codes or account identifiers may look numeric but need to remain text. Inspect the resulting JSON types before importing the data into another system.
Can I paste tab-separated spreadsheet data?
The parser expects comma-separated values. Export or prepare CSV first, quote fields that contain commas, and use consistent column counts.
text-case-converter: Will it preserve brand names and acronyms?
Automatic case rules can change deliberate capitalization. Review names, acronyms, and headings manually after converting.
No. The tool changes the presentation of the text; it does not translate meaning or correct grammar. Keep the original when applying changes to a long passage.
text-diff-checker: It compares pasted plain text by line. Fonts, page layout, tracked changes, and rich-text formatting are not part of the comparison.
Why does a moved line appear twice?
A line-based comparison can represent a move as a removed line and an added line. Read those changes together before accepting a revision.
uuid-generator: Can a UUID prove that someone owns a record?
No. An identifier names a record; authorization must still be checked by the application. Do not treat possession of a UUID as permission to access private data.
Do I still need a unique constraint?
Yes. Random version 4 UUID collisions are extremely unlikely, but storage should enforce uniqueness and handle conflicts rather than assuming they are impossible.
